findings.problem: guard_kit_apply_run lets unresolved spellings of the kit-apply run through: bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/scripts/kit-apply.sh, $(pwd)/..., $PWD/..., glob kit-appl*, bash < kit-apply.sh
findings.scenario: agent runs bash "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/.claude/scripts/kit-apply.sh in an installed project -> passes, the agent applies its own proposal

findings.problem: kit_rel/is_kit treat an absolute operand as not kit code
findings.scenario: git mv / merge-file / checkout-index -f -- / update-index --chmod / reset -- with $ROOT/.claude/hooks/x in an installed project -> pass
findings.closure: an absolute operand under the project root is made root-relative before is_kit; the 5 commands above deny, G19 rows

findings.problem: rebase only diffs HEAD...<first operand>: the <branch> operand and --onto target are not in the bring set
findings.scenario: git rebase main k, git rebase --onto k main, where k changes a hook -> pass
findings.closure: the bring set includes the rebase <branch> operand and the --onto target; both rows ask 'brings kit changes'

findings.scenario: git checkout - / git merge - (also rebase/cherry-pick -) to a branch changing a hook -> pass
findings.closure: '-' maps to @{-1} before the bring set; G19 rows ask 'brings kit changes'

findings.problem: writes reaching kit code through a folder, glob or contents copy only get the generic ask, not the kit deny
